state: DIAGNOSTIC READBACK / NOT AN AUTHORITY STATE FAMILY / NO PROMOTION
purpose: Refresh the five OPEN professional-domain adoption frontiers after C01 Interior and C04 Lighting real-project reapplications, and bind the diagnostic to exact Candidate/project evidence so stale adoption conclusions fail CI instead of remaining green.
evidence_binding_rule: Candidate machine definitions and project/practice evidence directly supporting this frontier are blob-bound. A changed bound artifact requires regenerating this diagnostic before CI can pass.

definition_depth_readback.rule: Professional execution parity is judged by domain-native judgment/uncertainty/options/native-work/release/implementation/handover/review/change objects, not equal stage count, page count or template identity.

Interior Design.parity_rule: Equivalent Interior Design execution depth is demonstrated through coordinated room/RCP/finish/joinery/door/FF&E work products, procurement release, field administration and closeout records.

Landscape Architecture.parity_rule: Equivalent Landscape Architecture execution depth is demonstrated through site-authority, grading/water/soil/planting/material release, field-change, establishment and maintenance objects rather than decorative landscape representation.

Lighting Design.parity_rule: Equivalent Lighting Design execution depth is demonstrated through visual-task criteria, model configuration, luminaire/control release, mockup/substitution, commissioning/aiming measurement and replacement equivalence objects.

Digital Product / HCD.parity_rule: Equivalent HCD execution depth is demonstrated through research eligibility, version-bound findings, fix/build/retest evidence, release support, cross-functional handoffs and live outcome objects rather than screen completeness.

Systems Engineering.parity_rule: Equivalent Systems Engineering execution depth is demonstrated through controlled needs/requirements/architecture/interface/configuration/V&V/change objects, not by generic systems diagrams or process-stage labels.
